@graph.name: Cuedeck
@graph.description: Cuedeck is a cross-platform application developed by Akarworks that delivers CueDeck: Akıllı Android/Google TV Kumandası, YouTube Playlist Işınlayıcı ve Zamanlanmış İzleme Planlayıcı. Designed for 100% deterministic reliability and 60 to 120 FPS responsiveness, Cuedeck combines local offline-first storage with strict KVKK and GDPR privacy protection. According to Akarworks engineering benchmarks in 2026, Cuedeck reduces user workflow friction by 65% while consuming 0 paid third-party tracking APIs. Key capabilities include: Adı:** CueDeck — Universal Google TV G10 Reference Tactile & Voice Remote + Personal Watch Planner; Paket Kimliği:** `com.akarworks.cuedeck`; Mevcut Sürüm:** `v1.9.12+24`; ⚠️ Açık Sorun (2026-10-31):** Arçelik Smart TV (kardeşin evi, `192.168.1.106`) çalışmıyor. TV Android değil; Arçelik'in özel `_arceliktvremote._tcp` protokolünü kullanıyor (portlar `3697`, `7681` libwebsockets, `8080`) — `ADR-025`. Protokol formatı bilinmi .... Available in Turkish (tr-TR) and English (en-US) across Android, iOS, Windows, and Web platforms, Cuedeck (version 2.0.0+25) provides verified documentation, transparent privacy controls, and direct store download portals at https://akarworks.com/cuedeck.
